case.question: Where has this WiFi access point been seen?

args.name: Example Signal Case
args.question: Where has this WiFi access point been seen?

plan.why: Record intake, create the case folder, strip sensitive values.
Public handle search across platforms; a hit is a candidate, not a match, until the identity gates pass.
Public leak-mention search plan (dry-run first); never download paste or dump content.
Breach check, dry-run unless keys are set in env; redacted output only.

One-input signal-database search for this BSSID / MAC / SSID / cell ID: WiGLE, Mylnikov, OpenCelliD, local Kismet / WiGLE files, plus key-required sources only if keys are set in signal-search config. Merged per-source lat/lon; >200 m disagreement flagged, not averaged away.
Profile snapshot (counts, bio, private/public) for baseline.
Like/comment sweep, max 5 posts, >=5s apart, stop on HTTP 429. A blocked sweep is not a negative finding.
Reverse-image guidance only: public sources, a match is a lead, not an identity, until the 6 gates pass.
Public-records search guidance (court, property, business, news); never merge same-name people.
Build a dated timeline from verified events only; flag UNVERIFIED-TIME where no raw timestamp exists.
Social graph from verified overlaps only; weak clues are not edges.
Structured report: findings with confidence, what was checked and found nothing, what could not be determined, next steps.
